scope: Actual root npm command starts the compiled TypeScript HTTP adapter in an independent temporary SQLite directory. No mock backend, Django process, account initialization, Orca click or vendor calls.
command: npm run start:local -- --data-root <owned isolated tmpfs> --port 0 --ui-origin http://127.0.0.1:5173
command_termination: SIGTERM sent to the owned npm process group; the npm parent exits on that signal, and the actual Core listener is then confirmed closed.
fixture_correction: The first verification incorrectly required a zero exit code after signalling the npm parent. It returned null with a termination signal; the fixture expectation was corrected before this complete verification. Production code was unchanged.
limitations: Command startup/bind time is not Electron cold-start latency.
No GUI, parsing/evaluation helper or real model tested in this step.
